subject: Elara Therapeutics: Private deployment readiness & certification cadence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@elaratx.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@elaratx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Elara Therapeutics: Private deployment readiness & certification cadence

Hi Samira / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, we want to align an operational cadence to get Elara's private deployment across VPC peering, private endpoints, and the on‑prem appliance over the next three sprints. I pulled together a compact runbook and some questions so we can lock the maintenance windows and cert checklist.

High-level proposal (please comment):
- Week 1 (prep): confirm CIDR ranges, NAT/egress expectations, and KMS/HSM access pattern
- Week 2 (peering + private endpoints): create peering, route tables, private DNS delegation; smoke test API connectivity
- Week 3 (appliance install + cutover): on‑prem appliance install, PKI sync, acceptance tests, fallback plan

Key asks for your networking team before we kick:
1) Confirm the VPC CIDR(s) you'll use and whether transit gateway will be in the path (we saw two candidate ranges in the spreadsheet).
2) Will you require BGP over the interconnect or static routes?
3) Which team owns your internal DNS zone delegation for private endpoints?
4) For the on‑prem appliance: who is the site contact and do they have console access during install?

I've attached a working CIDR spreadsheet and a short private endpoints checklist. Monica will map the firewall rules we recommend for your NOC.

Proposed kickoff: Tue Aug 10, 10:00am PT — 30m call for final clarifications. If that works, Monica will send the invite and a pre-reqs checklist.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: elara_vpc_cidr_and_subnets.xlsx, private_endpoints_and_dns-delegation.md
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@elaratx.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@elaratx.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Elara Therapeutics: Private deployment readiness & certification cadence

Ben — quick internal note and checklist I posted for the call. Copying the external thread so Elara sees context.

Internal checklist highlights (ops focus):
- Confirm CIDR overlap check (run automated verify against the spreadsheet) — action: Grace
- Generate recommended security group list (only required ports: 443, 8443 for internal API, 22 for appliance bootstrap) — action: Monica
- KMS/HSM: need RSA pubkey receipt and whom at Elara will approve CSR for device certs — action: security team
- DNS delegation: plan for a private zone like elara.internal.redwood -> require a secondary NS entry from Elara's DNS team
- Acceptance tests: tokenized call, KV load test (1m tokens), and cold start latency verification under 50ms p95 on dedicated pool

I'll prep the firewall rule template and the preflight ops runbook. Also suggest we request temporary jumpbox access during appliance install to avoid scheduling conflicts.

I'll attach a compact onprem install sequence PDF before the kickoff.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: onprem-install-sequence.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@elaratx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@elaratx.com>, Elara Networking <networking@elaratx.com>
Date: 2027-08-08T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Elara Therapeutics: Private deployment readiness & certification cadence

Ben / Monica — thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side before the kickoff:

- CIDR: We'll use 10.40.0.0/16 for the application VPC and 10.41.0.0/16 for analytics. Transit gateway not in the initial path — we prefer VPC peering between our app VPC and Redwood's peered VPC.
- Routing: we prefer static routes for the peering phase; we might move to BGP later when TGW is in play.
- DNS: Elara's infra team will create a private zone elara-internal.local and allow delegation; Rajiv will be the point for the DNS delegation ticket.
- On‑prem site contact: Priya Rao (priya.rao@elaratx.com) — she will be on site for the appliance install and can provide console access.

One compliance question: do you support an HSM-backed KMS where our keys never leave our HSM? We need to validate this before we sign off on acceptance tests.

We are good for Tue Aug 10 10:00am PT. Rajiv will invite our networking folks to join.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Engineering
Elara Therapeutics
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@elaratx.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@elaratx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Elara Therapeutics: Private deployment readiness & certification cadence

Samira / Rajiv — great, thanks for the quick answers and for confirming Priya as the on‑site contact. A few follow ups and confirmation of next steps:

1) CIDR and routing — noted (10.40/16 app, 10.41/16 analytics). We'll proceed with VPC peering + static routes for the initial rollout. I'll ask networking to build the peering request with those CIDRs.

2) DNS delegation — Rajiv, when you create the ticket can you include the NS records we'll need? Grace will provide the delegation template during the kickoff.

3) HSM-backed KMS — short answer: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via HSM integrations (we can work with your KMS provider to ensure keys never leave your vault). I'll loop our security SME in the kickoff call; Monica will follow up with a short security FAQ and the HSM integration checklist.

4) Appliance install window — Priya listed as on‑site. Please confirm a 4h window on Aug 17 (09:00–13:00 PT) for the appliance bring‑up and certificate exchange; we'll include a rollback plan in case we need to re-route to hosted endpoints.

Kickoff agenda (10:00am PT, Aug 10 — 30m):
- Introductions & contacts (5m)
- CIDR/peering confirmation & route plan (10m)
- DNS delegation & private endpoint naming (5m)
- Appliance install sequencing & acceptance tests (10m)

I'll send the meeting invite and add the drive folder with the runbook. Looking forward to getting this turned up.

Best —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
